item.title: Ab kisi baat pe dil dukhta nahi hai mera, — Heartbreak & Hijr Shayari
item.description: Ab kisi baat pe dil dukhta nahi hai mera, Tumne is hadd tak sataya hai ki patthar kar diya. Nothing hurts my heart anymore — you tormented me so deeply that you turned me to stone.
item.dc:creator: Dil_e_Beqasoor

item.title: Tum woh ladki thi, jisse sab hasna seekhte the... — Unspoken Love Shayari
item.description: Tum woh ladki thi, jisse sab hasna seekhte the... Jiski adaon se adaon mein rehna seekhte the... Jiske labon par kabhi bas hansi hua karti thi... Nazm, ghazalein zubaan par hua karti thi... You were that girl everyone learned to laugh from... whose grace taught elegance how to dwell in grace... on whose lips laughter was once a permanent home... poems and ghazals always danced upon your tongue...
item.dc:creator: Shayar_e_Fitrat

item.title: Tere saath guzara har lamha sambhaal rakha hai, — Unspoken Love Shayari
item.description: Tere saath guzara har lamha sambhaal rakha hai, Dil ke kisi kone mein tujhe chupa rakha hai, Waqt chahe kitna bhi aage nikal jaaye, Maine tumhaare har ek pal ko dil mein sajaa rakha hai... Every moment lived with you, I have safeguarded with care, hidden you gently in a quiet corner of my heart. No matter how far forward time may rush, I have adorned my soul with every memory of yours...
item.dc:creator: Dua_e_Qalb

item.title: Uske chehre mein is qadr noor tha, — Heartbreak & Hijr Shayari
item.description: Uske chehre mein is qadr noor tha, Ki uski yaadon mein to rona bhi manzoor tha, Bewafa bhi nahi keh sakte usko, Mohabbat to humne ki thi, woh to bekasoor tha. Such celestial radiance lived upon their face, that weeping in their memories felt completely welcome. I cannot even bring myself to call them unfaithful — love was chosen by my heart, they were completely innocent.
item.dc:creator: Aashna_e_Dard

item.title: Hazaron khwahishein aisi ki har khwahish pe dam nikle, — Life & Philosophy Shayari
item.description: Hazaron khwahishein aisi ki har khwahish pe dam nikle, Bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle. Thousands of desires, each so profound that one could die for it — many of my yearnings were fulfilled, yet so very few.
item.dc:creator: Mirza_Ghalib

item.title: Khamoshi se bhi guftagu ho jaati hai jab nazrein milti hain, — Unspoken Love Shayari
item.description: Khamoshi se bhi guftagu ho jaati hai jab nazrein milti hain, Lafzon ki zaroorat kise hai jahan roohein pighalti hain. Even silence breaks into conversation when gazes meet; who has need for words where souls dissolve into one.
item.dc:creator: Nigaah_e_Ulfat

item.title: Tera tagaful bhi ek ada thi, ye maan liya humne — Unspoken Love Shayari
item.description: Tera tagaful bhi ek ada thi, ye maan liya humne Ab har khamoshi ko teri baat samajh lete hain I accepted your neglect as just another grace of yours; now I take every silence for something you said.
item.dc:creator: Abr_e_Shab

item.title: Hijr ki shab bhi guzar jaati hai aahista aahista — Heartbreak & Hijr Shayari
item.description: Hijr ki shab bhi guzar jaati hai aahista aahista Bas ek chiraagh hai jo subah tak nahi bujhta Even the night of separation passes, slowly, slowly — only one lamp refuses to go out before dawn.
item.dc:creator: Banjara_Khwaab

item.title: Raat do baje phone ki roshni mein — Late Night Tanhai Shayari
item.description: Raat do baje phone ki roshni mein Teri purani tasveer musalsal dekhi Kuch nahi badla, bas itna hua Ab aankhein bhi kaagaz ki tarah bhigti hain At two at night, in the glow of a phone, I looked at your old photograph, without pause. Nothing changed, except this — now my eyes soak through like paper.
item.dc:creator: Siyahi_Qaasid

item.title: Qafas khula tha, parinda phir bhi na gaya — Life & Philosophy Shayari
item.description: Qafas khula tha, parinda phir bhi na gaya Aadat bhi ek zanjeer hai, ye ab samjhe The cage stood open; still the bird did not leave. Habit too is a chain — only now I understand.
item.dc:creator: Khamosh_Musafir

item.title: Tumne chai mein cheeni kam daali thi — Unspoken Love Shayari
item.description: Tumne chai mein cheeni kam daali thi Qurbat ka swaad phir bhi meetha tha You put too little sugar in the tea; closeness tasted sweet regardless.
item.dc:creator: Shab_e_Farda

item.title: Firaaq ki raah mein mahtab bhi tanha nikla — Heartbreak & Hijr Shayari
item.description: Firaaq ki raah mein mahtab bhi tanha nikla Jise chiraagh samjha, woh dhuaan nikla Teri justajoo mein shehar shehar phire Har ek dar pe tera hi nishaan nikla On the road of parting, even the moon walked alone; what I took for a lamp turned out to be smoke. Searching for you I wandered city to city — on every door I found only your mark.
item.dc:creator: Rubaab_Nawaz

item.title: Hum woh chiraagh nahi jo hawa se darr jaayein — Life & Philosophy Shayari
item.description: Hum woh chiraagh nahi jo hawa se darr jaayein Bujha bhi do to dhuaan aasmaan likhega I am not the lamp that fears the wind — put me out, and my smoke will write across the sky.
item.dc:creator: Baghi_Qalam

item.title: Station ki bench pe baitha hoon — Late Night Tanhai Shayari
item.description: Station ki bench pe baitha hoon Gaadiyaan aati hain, jaati hain Intezaar ka koi time-table nahi hota Shab yahin pe ruki rehti hai I sit on a station bench; trains arrive, trains leave. Waiting keeps no timetable — the night simply stays here.
item.dc:creator: Lantern_Wala

item.title: Ranjish hi sahi, ek baar to palat ke dekho — Unspoken Love Shayari
item.description: Ranjish hi sahi, ek baar to palat ke dekho Malal bhi tumhara ho to dil ko qubool hai Even in resentment, turn back once and look; if the regret is yours, my heart accepts it.
item.dc:creator: Dil_e_Nadaan

item.title: Shabnam si thi teri pehli baat — Unspoken Love Shayari
item.description: Shabnam si thi teri pehli baat Subah tak bhi na rahi magar Ek arzoo reh gayi kaagaz pe Jaise rooh ka koi safar Your first words were like dew — though they did not last till morning. One wish remained upon the paper, like a journey of the soul.
